final.memo:
The Company operates a sophisticated fleet of gas, nuclear, and coal power generation assets that currently suffers from a valuation gap driven by the market's obsession with merchant power cyclicality [D01, D05]. We believe this represents a fundamental mispricing; the business is not a commodity play, but a critical, high-margin provider of the zero-carbon, dispatchable power required for the AI data-center super-cycle [D03, D05].

Valuation math suggests significant upside. At a 14x forward EBITDA multiple on 2026 earnings power, the implied value is approximately $118 per share, a meaningful premium to our current entry price [D04, D06]. The Company’s 14.3% GAAP FCF yield provides a robust floor that is currently under-appreciated by investors who focus on historical commodity-price sensitivity [D04, D05].

Unlike its peers, The Company achieved 7.7% growth in 2023, outpacing Constellation and NRG, while maintaining an 18% operating margin [D06]. The market continues to apply a cyclical discount, ignoring the shift toward a more stable, base-load nuclear and carbon-free revenue profile [D01, D03, D05].

Management, led by CEO Jim Burke, has proven its execution capability through the simplification of the capital structure and the successful, FERC-approved acquisition of Talen assets [D01, D02, D03]. Our role is to support the board’s proactive capital allocation strategy—specifically the $1.5 billion share repurchase program—as the market acknowledges the company's new role as a core infrastructure beneficiary [D02].

Risks include integration friction from recent acquisitions, commodity volatility, and regulatory uncertainty regarding nuclear policy [D01, D05]. We size this at 4% of NAV to reflect the high conviction in the earnings inflection, while utilizing index puts to hedge sector-specific beta [D05].
